name: Muhammad Ali Jinnah
contribution: He led the demand for Pakistan and negotiated the political framework that brought East Bengal into the new state.
context: All-India negotiations over constitutional transfer and partition.
impact: No single figure was more central to the creation of Pakistan, of which East Bengal became a major eastern wing.
